source_message.text:
I've just spotted a bug in the gameification mechanics.

We need to remove 'top affiliate prizes' and use this approach instead:
Small blocks - award 5 x $500 prizes to randomly selected affiliates of the block.
Big blocks - award 5 x $20k prizes to randomly selected affiliates of the block.

The more 'tickets' earned, the greater the chances of winning.
